purpose: Makes a person record in a named vault, finds candidate people first, and refreshes the lists afterwards.
namedChanges: The imports are the peers `pick-or-create`, `tag-client`, `record-sync`, `vocabulary-source`, `stakeholder-field-sets`, `vault-origin-rule`, `record-cache-kit`, `plan-record-hooks`, `lws-records`, `term-origin`, `stakeholder-card-vocabulary`, `platform-fetch`, `plan-self-source`, `self-card`, `lws-relations` and `ontology-reads`, and the third-party `@tanstack/react-query`; `./canWriteVault` and `./plainBoundStep` are the unit's own.

The interface `PersonCreateHost` is added and exported; `recordPerson(deps, input)` is `recordPerson(host, deps, input)` and `adderCardOf(` is `host.adderCardOf(`; `afterRecordPerson(qc, made)` is `afterRecordPerson(host, qc, made)` and `rememberCreatedIn(` is `host.rememberCreatedIn(`, with the same arguments.

`export const PICKER_READING_QUERY_KEY = ["gilb-stakeholders", "picker-reading", GILBVEDA_MASTER_ORIGIN] as const;` is `export function pickerReadingQueryKey() { return ["gilb-stakeholders", "picker-reading", termOrigin()] as const; }`; its use is `queryKey: pickerReadingQueryKey()` and the two overload types `typeof PICKER_READING_QUERY_KEY` are `ReturnType<typeof pickerReadingQueryKey>`.
`canWriteVault` (types.ts lines 213-217) and `plainBoundStep` (boundAwait.ts lines 9-12) are copied into their own files: no merged unit holds them.
Comments that name a cycle, a ticket, an agent, a person, a ruling or the host app are reworded; no code changed. No string literal carries a tag.
